svg.text: Reference-driven agentic video generation: modes, shared logic and evidence boundaries
● Research prototype · read-only evidence portfolio style
approved keyframes → Kling I2V → final video
Separate backend, not the keyframe-first Mode A/B core
The implemented evidence preserves shot structure and action intent; it does not claim exact frame-level motion transfer.
Automatic Stage-4 scoring remains partial, and Mode C is shown as feasibility evidence only.
